newsitem.title: UK: Russian bank eyes Rosneft oil co - FT report.
newsitem.headline: Russian bank eyes Rosneft oil co - FT report.

text.p: The president of the Russian bank Oneximbank, Vladimir Potanin, aims to try and acquire the last major state-owned oil company in Russia when it is privatised later this year, said the Financial Times on Friday.
The FT report, based on an interview with Potanin, said the banking boss believed the oil group Rosneft would fit in with existing interests.
The sale of Rosneft could raise more than $1 billion.
